## Current project

<div class="entry">
<span class="entry-meta">Jan 2026 – present</span>
<div class="entry-title">Junior Research Fellow, Centre for Women's Studies</div>
<div class="entry-where">Acharya Nagarjuna University · under Prof. Challapalli Swaroopa Rani</div>

A UGC-funded study of how mining-led development is reshaping tribal women's labour and livelihoods in the Eastern Ghats. I contribute literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and drafting on rights, livelihoods and governance questions.

I helped secure the project's grant from the University Grants Commission, designing the proposal's methodology section and preparing the budget and supporting documentation.
</div>

## Previous positions

<div class="entry">
<span class="entry-meta">Feb 2025 – Dec 2025</span>
<div class="entry-title">Policy Researcher</div>
<div class="entry-where">Office of Waheed Ur Rehman Parra, MLA · Jammu &amp; Kashmir Legislative Assembly</div>

- Drafted policy briefs informing legislative debates on public service delivery and migration governance in a conflict-affected region, synthesising academic evidence, government data and international frameworks.
- Contributed to a senior fellow-led analysis of a 10,000-row migration dataset from conflict-affected districts using R and Stata, assisting with data preparation and with interpreting findings on displacement drivers and access to education.
- Conducted a comparative budget analysis of education funding in conflict regions and proposed equity-oriented allocation strategies.
